detail.longDescription: HackerTube and HackerBooks remind me of the awesome HN products I use daily: - hckr news: a collection of top stories. - hnrss: custom RSS feeds filtered by keywords and points. - HN Popularity: explore popular HN bloggers. Hacker News features a massive amount of high-quality content. To help discover and collect more great projects built around Hacker News, I built HN Atlas: https://hn-atlas.bensontech.dev/ - Collection of awesome HN products - Fast and static Look forward to hearing your favorite HN tools! Open source: https://github.com/wa008/hn-atlas
